## Presentation Title
**AI, Distilled**  
*Minimal intelligence in motion*

## Style Direction
- Cinematic premium minimalism: dark-room keynote, luxury tech editorial, quiet confidence
- Feels like an Apple launch film crossed with a Monocle/Wallpaper* feature on machine intelligence
- Spacious, restrained, atmospheric — every slide has one clear idea and one memorable visual moment
- Avoid generic robot imagery, neon clichés, cluttered dashboards, stock “AI brain” graphics, busy bullet slides
- Mood: intelligent, precise, mysterious, calm, future-facing

## Core Artistic Direction
- Photography: abstract macro imagery — glass, light beams, silicon wafers, human silhouettes, workspaces, reflective black surfaces
- Typography: oversized editorial serif headlines paired with clean Swiss grotesk body text; minimal captions in mono
- Texture/effects: subtle film grain, soft bloom, glassmorphism panels, low-contrast shadows, faint scanlines
- Layout mood: magazine-like negative space, asymmetric framing, cinematic crops, single focal object per slide
- Color philosophy: deep charcoal, warm ivory, graphite, muted silver, electric blue accents used sparingly
- Diagram style: ultra-clean thin-line systems, floating nodes, elegant data paths, architectural AI layers
- Animation energy: slow fades, gentle parallax, precise line-draw reveals, calm zoom-ins, no flashy transitions
- Overall finish: premium keynote polish, editorial restraint, cinematic silence, high-end technology atmosphere

## Color Palette

**Obsidian AI** `#080A0F` — primary cinematic background.  
**Graphite Glass** `#161A22` — panels, cards, dark editorial blocks.  
**Neural Blue** `#2F6BFF` — core AI accent, diagrams, active states.  
**Quantum Cyan** `#4DEBFF` — glowing data lines, highlights, HUD details.  
**Synthetic Violet** `#7B5CFF` — premium gradient depth, AI aura effects.  
**Soft Platinum** `#E8ECF2` — primary text on dark backgrounds.  
**Mist Gray** `#AAB2C0` — secondary copy, captions, metadata.  
**Signal Green** `#38F2A0` — success states, model outputs, key metrics.  
**Warm Intelligence** `#F4B860` — human-centered emphasis, ethical notes.  
**Editorial White** `#FAFAF7` — clean magazine-style contrast slides.  

## Typography

**Hero: Neue Haas Grotesk Display** — 72–120pt, 600–700, cinematic cover titles and big AI statements.  
**Section: Canela Deck** — 44–72pt, 400–500, elegant editorial chapter openers.  
**Body: Inter** — 18–26pt, 400–500, clean explanatory AI content.  
**Caption: IBM Plex Mono** — 11–15pt, 400–500, labels, model specs, dataset notes, UI metadata.  
**Emphasis: Editorial New Italic** — 30–54pt, 400 italic, poetic pull quotes and human/AI contrast moments.  

| Hierarchy | Size |
|---|---:|
| Hero | 88–120pt |
| Section | 52–72pt |
| Body | 18–24pt |
| Caption | 11–14pt |

## Layout System
- 12-column premium editorial grid with 96px outer margins; use disciplined whitespace and asymmetrical balance.
- Alternate full-bleed cinematic hero slides with restrained magazine-style text spreads.
- Use oversized AI headlines anchored bottom-left or center-left, never default centered title layouts.
- Bleed rules: imagery may bleed on top/right edges; text stays inside safe margins with high contrast overlays.
- Composition types: neural-network hero frames, split-screen human/machine contrasts, floating data cards, cinematic dashboard panels.
- Keep each slide minimal: one dominant visual idea, one headline, one supporting line or metric.

## Animation Style
- Transitions: slow cinematic cross-dissolves, soft zoom cuts, occasional horizontal editorial wipe.
- Entrances: text fades in with 12–20px upward drift; diagrams draw on as glowing vector paths.
- Speed/easing: 500–900ms, ease-out cubic; hero image motion uses slow 6–8s Ken Burns push.
- Motion ideas: pulsing neural nodes, flowing data particles, scanning light sweeps across model diagrams.
- Use subtle parallax between foreground typography and background AI visuals.
- Avoid flashy tech gimmicks; keep motion premium, quiet, precise, and atmospheric.

## Visual Requirements
- Photography style: cinematic low-light labs, abstract server rooms, human silhouettes, glass reflections, premium editorial contrast.
- Illustration type: elegant thin-line neural networks, minimal robotic forms, abstract intelligence landscapes.
- Diagram aesthetic: Apple keynote meets Bloomberg terminal—clean architecture maps, glowing flows, dark-mode panels.
- Texture/overlay notes: subtle film grain, glassmorphism panels, soft gradients in deep navy, graphite, silver, and electric blue.
- Use macro details: code fragments, circuit traces, fiber-optic light, eye reflections, hands interacting with interfaces.
- Keep visuals minimal and luxurious; no clip art, cartoon robots, generic stock icons, or cluttered dashboards.

## Slide-by-Slide Structure

### ACT I

**Slide 1 — The Quiet Arrival**
- Mood: Cinematic, premium, restrained wonder — AI introduced not as a machine, but as a silent new atmosphere entering human life.
- Layout: Full-bleed dark editorial cover with a single luminous neural thread crossing diagonally; title placed low-left with generous negative space, like a luxury magazine opening spread.
- Visual: Abstract macro-style image of soft glowing data particles suspended in black space, resembling dust in a projector beam; subtle silhouette of a human profile barely visible in shadow.
- FX: Slow cinematic push-in; neural thread gently pulses; title fades in letter-by-letter with a refined 300ms delay; faint ambient particle drift.
- Color: Deep obsidian black, graphite gray, soft electric blue, pearl white highlights, tiny accents of champagne gold.
- Type: Large elegant serif title in thin weight; small uppercase editorial caption above it: “A MINIMAL TEST PRESENTATION ABOUT AI”; body text minimal, no bullets.

**Slide 2 — Intelligence Becomes Interface**
- Mood: Sophisticated and contemplative — the moment where invisible computation becomes something humans can touch, ask, shape, and trust.
- Layout: Split editorial composition: left 40% clean text column on warm off-white; right 60% cinematic visual panel with rounded corners and soft shadow, resembling a premium tech magazine feature.
- Visual: Minimal human hand hovering over a translucent AI interface; floating prompt box, soft waveform, and faint branching neural diagram behind glass-like UI layers.
- FX: Interface elements assemble slowly from thin lines; cursor blink animation; neural branches draw themselves with luminous strokes; gentle parallax between hand, glass UI, and background.
- Color: Warm ivory background, charcoal typography, pale cyan interface glow, muted silver-gray UI lines, subtle amber warmth on skin tones.
- Type: Refined serif headline top-left; concise sans-serif subtext beneath; micro-labels in monospaced uppercase around the interface for a premium editorial-tech feel.

**Slide 3 — From Model to Meaning**
- Mood: Cinematic clarity — transforming the abstract idea of AI into a simple visual story of input, reasoning, and output.
- Layout: Horizontal narrative diagram across the slide: “Signal” on the left, “Model” in the center, “Meaning” on the right; each stage housed in elegant editorial cards floating over a dark gradient canvas.
- Visual: Three premium visual metaphors: scattered text fragments and images flowing into a luminous black-box model, then emerging as structured insight, image, code, and decision paths.
- FX: Data fragments drift from left to center; central model glows with a slow heartbeat pulse; outputs unfold like magazine cards sliding into place; thin connector lines animate with traveling light.
- Color: Midnight navy gradient, luminous cyan data streams, soft violet shadows, clean white cards, restrained gold accent lines.
- Type: Oversized serif title at top center; stage labels in small uppercase mono; card text in crisp modern sans-serif with very short phrases only.

### ACT II

**Slide 4 — The Machine Begins to See**
- Mood: Quiet revelation, like a cinematic lab scene where invisible intelligence slowly becomes visible.
- Layout: Full-bleed dark editorial canvas with one oversized central visual; minimal annotation lines orbiting the subject like museum labels.
- Visual: Abstract neural vision system: glowing image-recognition grid over a human eye, camera lens, and cascading data fragments.
- FX: Slow scan-line sweep across the image; soft node pulses; subtle parallax between eye, grid, and data layers.
- Color: Deep graphite, electric blue, soft violet, thin white interface lines, faint silver highlights.
- Type: Large premium serif title bottom-left; tiny monospaced technical captions along the grid edges.

**Slide 5 — Language Becomes Interface**
- Mood: Elegant, intimate, almost magical — a conversation turning into architecture.
- Layout: Split editorial spread: left side minimal text prompt; right side blooming generative response as layered translucent cards.
- Visual: Floating text fragments transforming into UI panels, diagrams, images, code, and voicewave patterns.
- FX: Words gently assemble letter by letter; response cards unfold with glassmorphism motion; ambient glow follows key phrases.
- Color: Warm ivory background, charcoal text, cobalt accent, pale gold highlights, translucent blue-white panels.
- Type: Refined serif headline at top; clean sans body text; monospaced micro-labels for “prompt,” “context,” and “output.”

**Slide 6 — Inside the Black Box**
- Mood: Mysterious, premium, cinematic — like opening the engine room of a futuristic cathedral.
- Layout: Central cutaway diagram occupying 70% of the slide; sparse editorial notes in the margins.
- Visual: Layered AI model architecture shown as glowing stacked chambers: data, embeddings, attention, reasoning, output.
- FX: Animated light traveling through the layers; attention paths shimmer; diagram labels fade in sequentially.
- Color: Matte black, midnight navy, luminous cyan, muted emerald, soft amber signal traces.
- Type: Minimal uppercase section title; precise technical labels in monospaced type; one bold serif pull-quote near the bottom.

**Slide 7 — From Prediction to Possibility**
- Mood: Expansive, optimistic, cinematic — the moment AI leaves the lab and enters the world.
- Layout: Wide panoramic composition with four elegant vertical panels: health, creativity, climate, productivity.
- Visual: Premium documentary-style vignettes: doctor reviewing AI scans, designer generating concepts, climate dashboard, worker using intelligent assistant.
- FX: Gentle cross-panel light sweep; each vignette gains a soft animated data halo; final unified glow connects all panels.
- Color: Clean off-white, deep navy, soft teal, restrained gold, subtle editorial gray.
- Type: Oversized serif title across the top; small sans captions beneath each panel; one-line closing statement centered at the bottom.

### ACT III

**Slide 8 — The Machine Begins to See**
- Mood: Quiet revelation, like watching intelligence awaken behind glass.
- Layout: Full-bleed cinematic image with a thin editorial caption rail on the left; one oversized title anchored bottom-right.
- Visual: Abstract AI vision system interpreting a city at night — bounding boxes, glowing silhouettes, depth maps, reflections on wet streets.
- FX: Slow parallax push through the city; faint scanning lines drift across the image; labels appear like whispered annotations.
- Color: Midnight black, electric blue, soft silver, small accents of warm amber from streetlights.
- Type: Elegant condensed serif title, minimal mono captions, generous spacing, museum-label restraint.

**Slide 9 — Language as Architecture**
- Mood: Intellectual, premium, poetic — words becoming structure.
- Layout: Split editorial spread: left side a vast white space with a single quote; right side a luminous 3D lattice made from floating text fragments.
- Visual: Sentences, tokens, and semantic nodes forming a cathedral-like neural architecture suspended in darkness.
- FX: Text particles gently assemble into beams and arches; subtle glow pulses through connections; quote fades in line by line.
- Color: Warm ivory, graphite, champagne gold, deep navy shadows.
- Type: Large italic editorial quote, refined sans-serif body notes, tiny mono token labels.

**Slide 10 — The New Creative Partner**
- Mood: Cinematic studio energy, elegant and human-centered.
- Layout: Magazine-style three-panel composition: artist, engineer, strategist — each paired with an AI-generated visual echo.
- Visual: A premium creative workspace with sketches, code, storyboards, holographic mockups, and AI suggestions hovering like translucent notes.
- FX: Soft paper-slide transition between panels; glowing idea trails connect human hands to machine-generated concepts.
- Color: Charcoal, porcelain white, muted cobalt, soft magenta highlights, warm desk-lamp gold.
- Type: Bold editorial headline across the top; handwritten-style micro-notes near artifacts; clean sans-serif captions below each panel.

**Slide 11 — Trust Is the Interface**
- Mood: Serious, cinematic, calm — the ethics chapter of a premium documentary.
- Layout: Minimal dark canvas with a central glowing balance diagram; four surrounding editorial cards: transparency, safety, bias, control.
- Visual: Abstract glass interface showing an AI decision path, with human oversight represented as a steady golden thread through the system.
- FX: Cards fade in sequentially; decision path illuminates slowly; golden thread draws itself from left to right.
- Color: Deep obsidian, mist gray, restrained gold, cool blue highlights.
- Type: High-contrast serif title centered above; precise mono labels for system elements; short editorial card text with ample breathing room.

**Slide 12 — The Machine Learns in Silence**
- Mood: Quiet, intelligent, cinematic tension; like watching a hidden system wake up beneath glass.
- Layout: Minimal editorial spread with a single oversized neural-network diagram floating center-left, surrounded by large negative space; one short insight block anchored bottom-right.
- Visual: Abstract black-glass AI model architecture: glowing nodes, thin luminous connections, subtle data pulses moving through layered translucent planes.
- FX: Slow parallax drift through the network; faint particle movement; one elegant line-draw animation revealing the model structure.
- Color: Deep obsidian, graphite gray, cold white, electric blue micro-glows, soft silver gradients.
- Type: Premium serif title in large scale at top-left; small mono technical caption beneath diagram; restrained sans-serif body text.

**Slide 13 — Signals Become Meaning**
- Mood: Refined, analytical, almost surgical; the transformation of raw data into insight feels poetic and precise.
- Layout: Three-stage horizontal cinematic sequence: Data → Pattern → Prediction, each stage inside a premium glass panel with generous spacing.
- Visual: Left panel: chaotic streams of numbers; center panel: clustering constellation; right panel: clean predictive waveform emerging from darkness.
- FX: Data particles flow left to right; panels illuminate sequentially; final prediction line draws itself with a soft glow.
- Color: Charcoal background, pearl-white typography, cyan highlights, muted violet shadows, subtle champagne accents.
- Type: Large editorial headline centered above sequence; mono labels for each stage; minimal explanatory text in small uppercase tracking.

**Slide 14 — The Human Question**
- Mood: Cinematic, ethical, contemplative; a premium magazine essay moment about trust, judgment, and responsibility.
- Layout: Full-bleed portrait-style composition: human silhouette facing a luminous AI interface; quote text placed dramatically in the empty negative space.
- Visual: A person seen from behind in a dark room, soft rim light outlining their profile, transparent AI decision layers hovering ahead like architectural glass.
- FX: Gentle breathing glow from the interface; slow camera push-in; quote fades in word-by-word with restrained elegance.
- Color: Midnight navy, warm skin highlights, soft ivory text, restrained blue-white interface light, faint amber ethical accent.
- Type: Oversized italic serif quote as hero typography; tiny sans-serif attribution line; no bullets, no clutter.

**Slide 15 — Intelligence, Designed Carefully**
- Mood: Hopeful, premium, future-facing; the final frame feels like an Apple keynote closing crossed with a cinematic documentary ending.
- Layout: Centered minimalist closing composition: glowing AI core on horizon line, title beneath, three small closing principles aligned at bottom.
- Visual: Abstract sunrise over a dark digital landscape; a calm luminous sphere made of data threads hovering above a reflective surface.
- FX: Slow sunrise bloom; subtle lens flare; data threads gently orbit the sphere; final title resolves with a soft cinematic fade.
- Color: Black, deep blue, silver-white, restrained gold sunrise gradient, delicate cyan edge light.
- Type: Elegant serif closing title centered; three principles in small uppercase sans-serif: “Clarity · Trust · Human Direction”; generous whitespace.
